signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Lead cross-functional teams to define, prioritize, and deliver product features and enhancements aligned with business objectives, user needs, and technical constraints
Apply user research, usability findings, analytics, and stakeholder input to inform product decisions
Act as a strong advocate for end users, ensuring their needs are clearly understood and reflected in product requirements
Work with Business Analysts (BAs) to translate product vision and feature ideas into clear, actionable requirements, including user stories, acceptance criteria, and definitions…
Manage prioritization within an evolving roadmap, balancing near-term delivery with long-term strategy
Understand goals and outcomes for this highly visible data sequencing initiative.
Work closely with the Customer Experience team and incorporate learnings from outreach into SRA Product Roadmaps
Drive product roadmap to meet milestones and timelines to stay aligned with high-visibility deliverables
Facilitate sprint planning and backlog grooming activities within the product team in order to drive timely product releases
Prepare and review product requirements documents, establish success criteria, and KPIs
